title: Word Mail Merge — Generate Offer Letters
description: Use Word Mail Merge to generate personalized offer letters from an Excel data source
objective: Students will create an offer letter template in Word, connect it to an Excel data source, and generate personalized letters for multiple candidates

steps.title: Create the Data Source in Excel
steps.instructions:
Open Excel and create a new workbook. Save it as **"candidates.xlsx"**.

Create these columns in Row 1 and fill 5 rows of data:

| Name | Position | Department | Salary | Start_Date | Manager |
|------|----------|------------|--------|------------|--------|
| Rahul Sharma | Junior Developer | Engineering | 25000 | 01-Aug-2026 | Priya Patel |
| Anita Singh | UI Designer | Design | 22000 | 01-Aug-2026 | Amit Kumar |
| Deepak Verma | Data Analyst | Analytics | 28000 | 15-Aug-2026 | Sneha Rao |
| Meera Nair | QA Tester | Engineering | 23000 | 01-Sep-2026 | Priya Patel |
| Karan Joshi | Content Writer | Marketing | 20000 | 01-Aug-2026 | Rohit Gupta |

Format Salary as Number (no decimals) and Start_Date as DD-MMM-YYYY.

Save and close the file.

steps.title: Create the Letter Template in Word
steps.instructions:
Open Word → create a new blank document.

Type the offer letter template:

```
TechPath Institute Pvt. Ltd.
123 Tech Park, Pune, Maharashtra 411001
Phone: +91-20-12345678 | Email: hr@techpath.biz

[Today's Date]

Dear [Name],

Sub: Offer of Employment — [Position]

We are pleased to offer you the position of [Position] in the [Department] department at TechPath Institute.

Please find the details of your offer below:

Position: [Position]
Department: [Department]
Monthly CTC: ₹[Salary]
Start Date: [Start_Date]
Reporting Manager: [Manager]

Please confirm your acceptance by signing and returning this letter by [date + 7 days].

We look forward to welcoming you to the TechPath team.

Sincerely,

HR Department
TechPath Institute Pvt. Ltd.
```

Format it professionally:
- Company name: 16pt, Bold
- Body: 12pt, Times New Roman
- 1.5 line spacing
- Proper margins (Normal)

steps.title: Connect Mail Merge
steps.instructions:
Go to **Mailings** tab → **Start Mail Merge** → **Letters**.

Click **Select Recipients** → **Use an Existing List** → browse to your **candidates.xlsx** file → select Sheet1.

Now replace the placeholder text with merge fields:
1. Select `[Name]` → click **Insert Merge Field** → choose **Name**
2. Select `[Position]` → Insert Merge Field → **Position**
3. Select `[Department]` → Insert Merge Field → **Department**
4. Select `[Salary]` → Insert Merge Field → **Salary**
5. Select `[Start_Date]` → Insert Merge Field → **Start_Date**
6. Select `[Manager]` → Insert Merge Field → **Manager**

The placeholders should now show as: «Name», «Position», etc.

For the date at the top, type today's date manually or use Insert → Date & Time.

steps.title: Preview and Generate Letters
steps.instructions:
Click **Preview Results** in the Mailings tab.

You should see the first letter filled with Rahul Sharma's details.

Use the **arrows** (◄ ►) to preview each candidate's letter. Check:
- Are all fields populated correctly?
- Is the salary showing properly?
- Is the date formatted right?

If something looks wrong → go back to the Excel file, fix the data, save, and preview again.

**Generate all letters:**
Click **Finish & Merge** → **Edit Individual Documents** → **All**.

A new document opens with ALL 5 letters, each on its own page. Save this as **"Offer_Letters_Aug2026.docx"**.

steps.title: Add Conditional Content (Bonus)
steps.instructions:
Go back to your template document.

Add a conditional paragraph that changes based on department:

Mailings → **Rules** → **If...Then...Else**
- Field: Department
- Comparison: Equal to
- Compare to: Engineering
- Insert this text: "You will be assigned a company laptop on your first day."
- Otherwise: "Please bring your own laptop for the first week."

Preview again — Engineering candidates see the laptop line, others see the BYOL line.

**Submit:**
1. The Excel data source file
2. The Word template with merge fields
3. The generated letters document (all 5 in one file)
4. Screenshot showing the conditional content working

expected_output: A Word mail merge template connected to Excel data that generates 5 personalized offer letters with conditional content based on department
